items.headline: Wall Street rallies toward an all-time high as AI-linked stocks lead gains
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq approached or reached record levels, with AI-related stocks contributing substantially to the market advance; Nvidia's market value approached $6 trillion and Constellation Energy rose after announcing a long-term electricity-supply agreement with Google.

items.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit all-time highs amid renewed AI enthusiasm
items.summary: A Bloomberg report carried by Moneycontrol said falling oil prices and renewed enthusiasm for the AI trade helped lift U.S. equities; Lisa Su described chip demand as very high, while UBS said AI investment remained a powerful market tailwind.
